items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, Ruby Fooz. That was years ago. She used to have a restaurant... Duke would never order just one dish... he used to call to this Chinese place

ctx.x: We got in to a conversation about Duke's eating habits, and you were telling me about Ruby Fooz in Boston?

Yeah, Ruby Fooz. That was years ago. She used to have a restaurant, which they have one in New York, but they use her name. But that was the real one; they had the door open to the kitchen so that you could see all the Chinamen cooking in there. Whatever you ordered was the real McCoy, and Duke would never order just one dish; he used to call, when they knew him, he used to call to this Chinese place and he would say, 'I'm coming there with maybe 1,2,3, people' and they would have a nice dinner ready for him; he…
You say he used to go there three o'clock in the morning and the place would be packed.
